title: True Man's World
description: This data pack is designed to make your survival more difficult without adding new mobs, using hardcore or reducing health to zero.
body:
This is a world for real men. In more detail, this project was created to evaluate my capabilities in creating data packs. What awaits you in it?

Burning hunger, random battles, crafts in hand and a secret additional difficulty with the ability to get bonuses for it. The data pack is designed for a long passage, about 15 hours for a full inspection of its components, if you do not use cheats. It is recommended to go through the game measuredly and not rush, although in some situations you will need haste.

Below will be spoilers for how to craft what items and how to get the "secret additional difficulty":


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

To start "healing", find two totems. Rename one in the anvil to "True man" and place two different totems in each hand, change until you are given a new one. This totem will need to be combined with the dragon egg and then you will get a potion (transition to additional difficulty if you drink it). After all these actions, you need to kill Wither and combine the potion with the star. After that, you will receive a book that you can eat. After eating it, you will become a man. To become a real man and get bonuses for the future game, you need to repeat all the actions with additional difficulty. Everything is the same, but the potion will be crafted from a sculk catalyst.

That's it! After this, you will completely complete the data pack, get rid of all the troubles and get an endless discount from the residents, thanks to the "Hero of the village" effect.

</details>

If you play with data packs or mods that use game attributes and change them not through modifiers, but through base, then, alas, they are very likely to conflict with this project.

The data pack was tested and created on the version Minecraft: Java edition 1.21 Fabric.

If you encountered bugs, you will be sad, because everything I wrote worked for me. Enjoy the game and rest assured that you will complete this World of Real Men.

If you liked the data pack and want to create something of your own based on it or use it to teach someone, then feel free to use it. If this data pack reminded you of any other, then it will be funny. After all, this data pack is not unique but was written from scratch by me.
